column4: The new 4,217-failure regression is produced by the neighbouring bearing clamp, which the rubric confirms is still gated on parent.is_none(), and the re-test clause names exactly that clamp.
Strictly-better superseding mechanism: a per-organism row histogram produces the identical number in O(cells+rows) against a quadratic flood.
Measured end-to-end cost (settled field 0.0002 -> 3.55 ms, field sleep destroyed) with a named reopening condition: a solver that settles under a steady forcing term.
Counterexample measured backwards (a sealed room retained less pressure than open air) plus the textbook no-penetration condition that superseded it.
Arithmetic impossibility: an 8-cell field block cannot resolve trails 4 cells apart, and the CA-resolution plane that supersedes it shipped at 0.0014 ms.
Superseding mechanism shipped and the flood is gone: rigid.rs now documents load::failing_region answering which cells fail, with label_failing_region removed (verified in source).
Disjoint call set by construction (0 moved against 452 refused) -- the rubric's named design-fault-in-the-mechanism case, not a measurement fault.
Arithmetic impossibility: the allele is clamped at the draw site, so a widened resolver can never be handed a wide value; the zero is explained and the injection control moved a guard red.
Measured on the cell-weighted ratio (13%/2.5%) with a named condition that changes the arithmetic: DENSITY_SUBSTEPS rising, or biomass moving into many small organisms.
Structural: the early exit in diffuse_heat is keyed on conductivity == 0, so any nonzero default makes every material pay four neighbour reads for nothing; explicit opt-in supersedes.
Strictly-better superseding mechanism: directed boundary-edge stitching is equivalent and unambiguous on binary occupancy, where marching squares' interpolation machinery has no problem to solve.
Cadence arithmetic: a per-frame decay zeroes the deposit in ~10 frames before any 45-frame Grow check can read it; per-organism-tick decay supersedes.
Owner blind A/B counterexample against the session's own prediction, and the named re-test condition is unmet -- Phase 3 cave shape is still unbuilt (Purpose::CaveVariety reserved and unused).
Measured leak arithmetic (0.27 at magnitude 5, 0.09 at 12, -0.967 only at 30); the flip-side caveat makes the rejection of a shallower gate stricter, not weaker.
Contradictory requirements: it removes the artifact only by destroying the property the rule exists for (water reads as sand), and LIQUID_SETTLE_DROP supersedes it at films 277 -> 0.
Geometric counterexample: the perpendicular edge is what separates rock along the ray, so the reversed orientation cuts rings instead of wedges.
Observed counterexample on screen (one-frame orange flash, no flame) plus the superseding position-and-time-bucket flicker with a heat_ratio hue ramp.
Structural: while income is per-column sky visibility under a height bound, the light-optimal stand IS the one-cell slab, so upward bias and trunk branching push growth into the artifact.
Measured at zero end-to-end and bit-identical by construction (verified by world hash), with the real cost driver identified separately; named condition is region count well past 80.
Paired end-to-end cost of +0.149 ms/tick with two named reopening conditions (wanting order-independent draws for architecture, or cheaper per-visit machinery).

The named condition is met -- a per-order tropism reference exists as plagiotropic_here in plant.rs -- and plant.rs:1092 records the re-measurement: weeping/upward_weight and tropism both fired and read as nothing.
Measured whole-frame repaint cost (7.997 ms mean against 0.012 ms settled, linear at 76 ns/pixel) with a named condition: a cell-granular repaint path that does not exist.
Counterexample on both sides: undercut spalling went to zero because per-cell weakness IS the mechanism, and at the cut the mean equals the minimum so it did not help its own case.
Structural: a rate knob cannot express a shape, so a lower brow_chance leaves the same comb only sparser -- the shape the owner rejected by name on residual_density.
Question 1: a withdrawn architectural rule with no mechanism attached -- reviving it would change design policy and documentation, not the engine.
Owner counterexample on the pattern (one weight everywhere is a binary outcome) plus the fixed-radius ring; the 12-run sweep caveat prices the replacement, not the rejection.
Superseding mechanism shipped -- DormantBud plus break_buds and a supportable count are in the tree -- and the frontier counterexample survives the LIGHT_DECAY-tuning caveat under rule A.
Structural: aux 0 is written both by the painter and by rigid::settle, so the guard reinstates the binary immunity four earlier models were rejected for (2 cells evaluated of 15,840).
Structural: a cell cannot locally distinguish an invalidation from a dead end, so the field ping-pongs at the same throughput; the closed-set reconvergence supersedes it (12.49 -> 0.25 ms).
Rule A: delete the 1.7x figure (measured when a get was a hash, now a ChunkGrid index) and the redundancy reason survives -- write_cell already returns the old value.
Question 1: a withdrawn inference with no mechanism attached, refuted by creature_arena's maximal-effect negative control.
Measured at 4.9% of step_organisms (0.16 ms of a 5.15 ms frame) against a 15% estimate, with named conditions: a pass restructure, or organisms far larger than 5,000 cells.
Structural: the opacity reader is field.rs's rebuild_blocked, not any plant rule, and the named re-test condition is unmet -- no opaque flag exists on Material (verified).
Structural: binary immunity means scene=ligament stands forever and one chip levels a castle; the capacity-multiplier form (attached_span_bonus, verified in load.rs) supersedes it.
The shared light channel at FIELD_SCALE=8 cannot carry gallery-versus-open; verified that BrainInput still offers only LightHere, with no per-cell light and no in-the-open sense.
External counterexample (real 2D sandpiles show no BTW power law) plus a superseding two-angle model, and the acceptance suite asserts the Gaussian distribution.
Structural: one angle cannot express hysteresis, so settled piles relevel to a single slope; two-angle repose supersedes it.
Two measured packing costs with a named reopening condition that is verified unmet: Cell still asserts 12 bytes and all eight aux flag bits are taken.
Costed at ~655 KB/frame saved (not a bottleneck) against a named condition -- a crate exposing partial uploads -- and Cargo.lock still pins pixels 0.17.2.
Structural: paced relaxation lets the count-to-infinity dynamic push cells past their span before the anchor arrives, producing a global collapse on frame one.
Contradictory requirement stated by the owner (a roof that falls in was declined) plus a monotone rising water table that is a binary arriving slowly, not a middle.
Contradictory requirements on one constant (player span strong, undercut shelf weak) with no setting that satisfies both -- the entry's own no-setting-exists arithmetic.
Superseding mechanism: a min-heap with a full total order fixes both the false O(due) claim and the engine's only documented non-determinism source.
The guard the rejection rests on is marginal only because #189's capillary and drying-brake constants were never re-derived -- a correct mechanism read at inherited constants.
The effect sits inside the harness's own published 2.42-3.12x seed-noise floor over six seeds, which the entry states outright; the unequal weight count is named as a second reason to distrust it.
Counterexample: the any-cover test is correct because whatever covers the cell falls into the vacated spot either way, and the narrow gate left every water-under-sand cell scanning.
Two attempts failing the same way: penalising the crossing cell relocates the tear as a throttle at the same seam (2236/1948 against 988 for correct ordering), and chunk decomposition is unchanged.
Counterexample: 63 bites removed only 77 cells because the bore's own spoil shielded the face; reaching past powder to the first hard cell supersedes it.
Arithmetic impossibility: three octaves concentrate near 0.5 by the central limit theorem, so folding the sum piles mass against the maximum (0.567) instead of producing rare crests.
The null is produced by an upstream defect (§R3: no multi-cell body holds a population) that is constant across the paired free/priced control and across flat slab and world alike.
Three seeds at a quarter of the round's frame budget with windfall counts of 0-2 -- below the sweep bar and inside the noise caution the entry itself invokes.
The entry records its own re-test on P2's flitter: the reach condition was met (35/45/58 rows against a 22-row flower) and flower_visits stayed at 5/2/0, moving the gap from reach to encounter.
Structural: per-call jitter means the crack-tip bonus can never find a fissure to extend, so blows repeat instead of accumulating; site-keyed jitter supersedes it.
Arithmetic impossibility: a 175-unit mutation step against herb's authored 60; verified that SpeciesRegistry::param_scale is still corpus-wide with no per-species or relative step.
Arithmetic: a whole-difference transfer overshoots equality and the alternating scan direction swaps it back forever (active chunks still nonzero at 24,000 frames).
A latent, unrelated vault_density overlap defect produced the failing test, isolated exactly by moving that one row back with nothing else changed.
The channel-B plane could not carry the gradient to a two-point sensor (31 nonzero cells in a 169-cell neighbourhood), and channel A at 12.7x the mass is the named untried arm.
Playtest counterexample at the bottom of the range (radius 2 correct in arithmetic and invisible on a cliff); the floor supersedes while keeping the brush scaling that was right.
Never built: full MPM was declined at design time against a ~16 ms CPU frame budget, with only its friction-angle parameterisation kept.
Rule A: the field measurements were all favourable, so the rejection rests entirely on eight starting positions in one sealed corridor, which the entry itself says is not a sweep.
Playtest counterexample: W is jump and climb, so jump-walking through a wood grabbed every trunk and read as hovering; an explicit grab key supersedes it.
Question 1: the thing rejected is the labgif harness's own knob interaction -- reviving it changes a rendered sheet's dimensions, not the engine.
Counterexample with a mechanical cause: loose tilth runs down update_powder's straight-down rule and closes the gallery (2/1 roofed void against 54/58 tamped).

Condition met and unactioned: the 4-bit packing is gone (canopy_density is now an f32 in the organism sidecar) yet CANOPY_DENSITY_DECAY_PER_TICK is still 0.5, with its own doc saying the re-tune was deferred.
Measured 2.7x frame time (62.56 against 23.06 ms) for an unchanged discrimination table, with a named condition: arching needing to discriminate deeper than 8 cells of cover.
Contradictory requirement: the only arm that recovers the guard's headline writes the cell at field capacity and mints water, which conservation forbids; the three shippable arms are a wash.
Decision 4's economy has landed -- intercepted-light income, q_peak maintenance and a leaf-declared Photosynthesize are in the tree -- and no cost/rate/reserve re-tune sweep is recorded.
The constant was sized against one write rather than against the balance the drops actually reach (0.031 of saturation world-wide); re-derivation from the steady state supersedes it.
Condition met and revived: the score is now divisive (score = preference / (1.0 + density * crowding_weight)) and every shipped species authors crowding_weight 30.0, far past the old cliff.
External counterexample: grafting experiments falsify meristem senescence, so any timer-based permanent tip retirement models a disproven mechanism.
Measured superseding mechanism: error diffusion reads 0.41 RMS departure against feedback's 0.65, and feedback makes the visible jitter worse (direction changes 66.5% -> 79.0%).
Counterexample: any cell buried more than dispersion cells from an opening has no legal move on any frame, so a wide column eroded only from its edges.
Superseding mechanism measured indistinguishable at 56,640 gas cells (own-tile array index), and the condition still holds -- World::fields is still an FxHashMap (verified).
Question 1: the thing rejected is the measurement horizon itself, a sweep method -- reviving it changes a comparison, not the engine.
Disjoint call set: sleeping cells are by definition not visited, so the coupling never fired for the case it was built for -- the rubric's named design-fault case.
Counterexample: roots are plant cells with the soil bed resting on them, so an ungated shake stirred 1,235 cells of soil against 429 when gated on open air.
Measured counterexample (35% establishment failure because an order-0 seedling sees only the trunk tier), and the juvenile/adult axis the clause names still does not exist.
Arithmetic: a max over a population is a statistic about its extreme member, so a threshold fitted above it excludes the exact case the threshold exists for.
Condition met, no re-test recorded: wood.ron and log.ron now ship ignition_temperature 400.0 and deadleaf.ron 320.0, so the heat-only path can light something today.
Counterexample (a puddle sat on damp ground forever) compounded by the gate making the conservation test pass against dead code; min(fill, room) supersedes it.
Measured scan cost (82,487 re-scanned primed cells against 1,160 at interval 3) with a named condition: a cheaper primed-site walk.

The named condition was direct chunk-array neighbour access instead of a World::get HashMap lookup per neighbour, and ChunkGrid has since made World::get a dense Vec index -- the ~10 ms figure predates the rebuilt cost baseline.
Structural: a per-frame-priced verb with a positive resting sum is a state rather than an outcome; the exactly-cancelled bias (squash(0.0) == 0.0) supersedes it.
Counterexample: 86% of one-frame debris landed immediately and refilled its own crater; staged spawning plus debris_fraction supersedes on both look and cost.
Structural trap: chunk sleep is keyed on writes, so a deferral that writes nothing lets the chunk settle and freezes the grain mid-water forever.

Condition met, no re-test recorded: the monotone high-water girth memory the clause gates on exists today as OrganismCell::q_peak, explicitly distinguishing a plant that lost foliage from one that never had any.
Counterexample: 0.000 humidification against 2.310 for the identical body three rows up; the moisture-only read-through exception supersedes it.
Measured only on a bed reading 0.000 available in every arm -- a scene with no gradient for the mechanism to express -- and the deep bed where the gate works is named and untested.
Structural: leaving aux at its default makes an entire generated world read anchored while being structurally invalid, so any scheduling change collapses it globally.
Rule A: delete the 8.1 -> 12.7 ms figure and the reason survives -- the dispatch site already holds the Cell, so the call-site guard is a Vec index against a per-cell lookup.
Magnitude arithmetic with the arms verified different (19.4% of the frame redrawn): a median move of 11 of 255 against a ~28-point intra-palette step, and the owner saw no difference.
Counterexample: total |pressure| after 200 steps went 2.9 -> 2177.8 with the clamp, and the clamp width is fixed by the halo the awake set provides, not chosen as a margin.
Observed counterexample rather than a null: the rule fires on every one-cell hole in dense tissue, 741 filled corners in a 64x40 crop, and the selector-mode re-test condition is unmet.
Structural: damage is recorded on boundaries so a face interior carries no mark; the zero is mechanically explained and the per-domain flag moved the numbers (6 -> 14 failures).
Counterexample: plant_creature_seed refused every site in the world at k=2 because supersampling away from the origin moved the anchor out of the head's block.
Structural: the load model's only verdicts are holds and fails, so reaching the clamp crushes pieces instead of laying them down; verified that load.rs still has no go-over outcome.
Structural: a compositional guarantee implemented by fixing the shape is not a parameter, so amplitude knobs cannot vary it; regional layout with a minimum elevation spread supersedes it.
Arithmetic impossibility: round(0.9*n) == n for n in 1..=5 is a non-decaying limit cycle, so residual flux never reaches a small epsilon.
Arithmetic: at 150 the levelling budget is unreachable by construction and the residual unevenness is visible, which is the bar this project judges by.
Arithmetic: at ~8 cells of cover a roof cell's mass is already below the cap, so min(mass, Hp) is the identity; the moment arm is the binding constraint and the A/B switch showed it.

Structural: relax_region seeds its boundary from stale-low outside values, and the arm that looked like a win was a vanished-work artifact caught by the SETTLE_GROUND control (max aux 142 against 2,482).
Arithmetic: a floor at grant+1 is not a margin, so a newborn breeds on one unit of energy and the colony becomes a birth-death treadmill visible in live, not in births.
Structural: leaf count scales with plant size while interception self-bounds via self-shading, so every tip's share never falls and the stand fuses (38,605 against 1,723 cells).
Three in-repo counterexamples of stale enumerations (light with no writer, canopy density with an always-zero reader, pressure with no consumer) plus the superseding World::set test that shipped.
Playtest counterexample (a one-row sky-to-dark transition read as way too intense and made every cave mouth a flat cutout); the 24-cell positional ramp supersedes it.
The rejection is a redundancy syllogism with no published measurement or spread at all, and the entry itself says only a sheet could settle it -- the rubric treats such a null as instrument-limited.
